title: Memory as the Backbone: A Dual-Store Associative Memory Architecture for Visual Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.33475v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We investigate whether explicit memory can serve as the organizing principle of a general-purpose visual backbone. Inspired by the interaction between working and long-term memory in human cognition, we introduce DuSAM (Dual-Store Associative Memory), a hierarchical memory-native visual backbone coupling image-local working memory (WM) with a fixed-capacity persistent semantic memory (PM). WM organizes local visual evidence into compact, spatially anchored states that are updated and transported across stages, then read back to refine dense features. PM consolidates semantic evidence from training images and annotated regions into prototypes, whose retrieved content enriches the same working states. With these memory operations in place of self-attention or state-space blocks, DuSAM achieves competitive performance relative to representative, similarly sized backbones on ImageNet-1K classification, ADE20K semantic segmentation, and COC

translated_title: 记忆作为主干：一种面向视觉识别的双存储联想记忆架构
translated_abstract: 我们研究显式记忆能否作为通用视觉主干网络的组织原则。受人类认知中工作记忆与长期记忆相互作用的启发，我们提出了DuSAM（双存储联想记忆），这是一种层次化的记忆原生视觉主干网络，将图像局部的工作记忆（WM）与固定容量的持久语义记忆（PM）相耦合。工作记忆将局部视觉证据组织成紧凑的、空间锚定的状态，这些状态在各阶段之间被更新和传递，随后被读取回来以精炼密集特征。持久语义记忆将来自训练图像和标注区域的语义证据整合为原型，其检索到的内容用以丰富同一工作状态。通过用这些记忆操作取代自注意力或状态空间模块，DuSAM在ImageNet-1K分类、ADE20K语义分割和COCO目标检测等任务上，取得了与同等规模的代表性主干网络相当的性能。
tldr: 提出了双存储联想记忆架构DuSAM，以工作记忆与持久语义记忆的记忆操作替代自注意力机制，构建出一种新型视觉主干网络，在ImageNet-1K分类、ADE20K分割和COCO检测上取得与同规模模型相当的性能。
en_tdlr: DuSAM is a dual-store associative memory visual backbone that replaces self-attention with working memory and persistent semantic memory operations, achieving competitive performance on ImageNet-1K, ADE20K, and COCO benchmarks.
